findings.description: CON-SUP-107 and CON-SUP-124 specify the CRC polynomial but not its initial value, input and output reflection, final XOR or stored-reference byte order. The expected comparison result for a given image and reference is therefore not unique.
findings.requested_change: Specify the CRC parameters and reference byte order once the product decision is made.

findings.description: The run-time CRC comparison lacks the initial value, input and output reflection, final XOR and reference byte order. CON-SUP-124 specifies the polynomial by reference and the reference location, but does not determine a unique comparison result.
findings.requested_change: Specify the CRC parameters and reference byte order once the product decision is made.

findings.description: CON-SUP-125 lists state labels without transition rules. SYS-SUP-051 selects STARTUP or OPERATIONAL between fault detection and safe-state entry, including during a start-up fault and after a code 8 report, although OP-SYS-015 identifies these cases as undecided.
findings.requested_change: Align the state selection with the product decision for these cases.

findings.description: SAFE applies from completion of safe-state entry until reset, while LATCHED applies while the safe state is latched. After a latch-triggering fault under SYS-SUP-028 or SYS-SUP-043 and completion of safe-state entry, both conditions apply, so the required state value is not unique.
findings.requested_change: Resolve and specify which state applies when the safe-state and latch conditions overlap.

findings.description: The configuration integrity comparison specifies only the CRC polynomial. OP-SYS-014 records missing CRC parameters and stored CRC byte order, so the expected result for a given configuration block and reference cannot yet be determined.
findings.requested_change: Specify the CRC parameters and stored CRC byte order once the product decision is made.
